name: final-cp-promotion-gate
applies_to: human physical CP metric (metric #3) on a NEW untouched, fully human-sealed, full-coverage benchmark ONLY
notes: Jaccard >= 0.90 mathematically forces F1 >= 0.947, so an F1=0.90 target is NOT sufficient.
Thresholds are frozen BEFORE the benchmark is opened; no post-hoc tuning.
Semantic vertex accuracy/Dice (metric #1) is reported in a SEPARATE table and does not count toward this gate.
Region-derived CP consistency (metric #2) does NOT count toward this gate (GT is auto-derived, not human).
Disqualifiers: any pending/unsigned label, any train/test overlap (SHA), selective-coverage hiding, or final-set threshold tuning.
